title: Failure Classification Proposal
description: Schema for reviewable failure-classification proposals generated from validated result records. Proposals are non-authoritative pending artifacts that require human adjudication before promotion to authoritative failure_classifications.

generator_version.description: Version of the failure_proposals module that produced this output.

source_experiment_id.description: Experiment ID from the source result records.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when proposals were generated.

input_record_count.description: Number of result records consumed as input.

proposals.description: Zero or more failure-classification proposals. Each references a specific result record.

by_category.description: Count of proposals per proposed category.

result_id.description: Composite identifier for the source result: '<condition_id>/<question_id>'.

question_id.description: Question ID from the source result record.

condition_id.description: Condition ID from the source result record.

proposed_category.description: Proposed failure category. 'unresolved' means no direct signal supports a specific classification.

review_status.description: Review status. Always 'pending' — proposals never auto-promote.

detail.description: Additional detail from the signal source (e.g. error message, event detail).

signals.description: Direct signals from the result record that support the proposal.

recorded_classifications.description: Pre-existing failure_classifications from the source record, preserved as annotations.

evidence.description: Evidence supporting the proposal, drawn directly from the result record.

reasoning.description: Human-readable explanation of why this category was proposed (or why it remains unresolved).

suggested_action.description: Suggested adjudication action for the reviewer.
